events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
By. This is Maria Alvarez, March 14th, 1968. I need a read.
One moment while I check your details.
Thank you, Maria. Which medicine do you need a refill request for?
Let me look at your record.
I found albuterol inhaler or budesonide inhaler. Which one do you mean?
I need to know which one you want. Is it albuterol inhaler or budesonide inhaler?
